tagline: Robotics and control, explained with the equations and the code.
description_footer: Remaining Action explains robotics and control research with original animations.

links.footer: Every number in the video comes from a script you can run: the explainer and its code are linked above.
links.note: Off by default: the video never refers to the explainer, code or site, and the description carries no link to them. Turn it on here, or for one run with the pipeline's 'links' input, to add the explainer and code links to the YouTube description only (never inside the video); that needs SITE_BASE_URL.

azure.note: Owner decision 2026-11-06: Azure en-US-Steffan:DragonHDLatestNeural is the narrator of the Remaining Action series (chosen over en-US-SamuelMultilingualNeural and others in a matched-pace comparison: about 150 words per minute, a 400 ms break between blocks, prosody rate -8 %). rate_pct -8 gives Steffan HD about 147-156 words per minute (measured 2026-11-06); a block faster than max_wpm (160, the top of the spoken-script standard's 140-160) is synthesized again at a slower prosody rate, never below min_rate_pct (-30: Steffan HD reads some sentences near 200 words per minute at 0 %, and -20 % still left one episode 1 block at 178). HD voices honour <prosody rate> and <break> and ignore mstts:silence (never used). Pauses come only from the service: punctuation, prosody rate, and a planned beat (an ellipsis in the narration) as a <break> of ellipsis_pause_s; the audio is never cut or spliced. HD takes are not deterministic: a take with an unplanned gap, an over-long word or a pace under min_wpm is synthesized again (up to retries times). Keys AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY and AZURE_SERVICE_REGION come from the environment only. Piper stays installed as the keyless voice (render_video.sh --voice piper); drafts are silent.

narrator.model: DragonHDLatest: follows Microsoft's latest model, not pinnable (no versioned name in the voice list, 2026-11-06)
narrator.reference: tools/video/voice_reference.py renders the fixed reference paragraph to voice-reference/ (git-ignored) at every voice change, for regression checks

voice.disclosure: Script, figures and animations were produced with an AI-assisted pipeline, checked by scripts and independent reviewers, and approved by a human before publication.
voice.policy: Voice policy (README.md): one canonical narrator per series; changes only at series boundaries, announced; AI voices never presented as real or as different people; a second voice only as a named, disclosed character; the back catalogue is re-voiced on a change; rendered narration WAVs are archived; the reference paragraph is rendered at each change.

video.loudness_note: Integrated loudness of the final mix (EBU R128), set by a fixed gain after a measurement pass; YouTube normalises to about -14 LUFS and turns quieter videos up never. The true-peak ceiling is music.true_peak_dbtp, measured after AAC encoding. Owner decision 2026-11-04 (was -16).

music.note: Owner decision 2026-11-04, route A: original music only. tools/video/music.py synthesises it (seeded by the run slug unless seed is set; preset calm-pad), tools/video/assemble.py mixes it: the bed sits bed_in_gaps_lu below the narration's loudness in pauses and bed_under_voice_lu below it while the narration speaks (a sidechain duck with look-ahead), the motif sting on the title beat after the hook ('hook_title') and on the outro ('outro') at sting_lu. Per scene (plan.json scenes "music": bed | low | off, default modes_by_role) after the coherence principle (Moreno and Mayer 2000: background music under narrated explanation lowers recall and transfer): the bed in the hook, title beat and outro, 'low' (low_under_voice_lu, at least 20 LU under the voice) or 'off' under explanation; a swell of transition_swell_s at every cut. tools/gate.py requires the provenance stamp video/final/music.json for any music in the mix. Licensed or commissioned tracks (route B) are not supported yet: source must stay 'generated'; enabled false gives a voice-only mix. Stings (2026-11-04, after the v2 final-cut review FC-1): placed in a pause of the narration so that they end sting_margin_s before the next word (music.py sting_slot()), and ducked under the voice by sting_duck_db as a safety net; the final gate requires every music element to stay at least music_under_voice_max_lu under the narration while it speaks (EBU R128 momentary loudness of the mixed music against the narration's integrated loudness, over whole spoken words). bed_under_voice_lu -16 -> -18 (2026-11-04): with -16 the bed's own swells and bells reached -11.5 LU over words in episode 1 v2.
